channel.title: PeakGlow
channel.description: Updates for PeakGlow, a notch glow utility for MacBooks.

item.title: PeakGlow 1.9.2
item.description:
PeakGlow 1.9.2

  • Fixed: at 100% on a charger, the controls no longer show a charging power and a time until full; the battery is shown as fully charged.

item.title: PeakGlow 1.9.1
item.description:
PeakGlow 1.9.1

  • Fixed: pulling the charger no longer flashes "Charging" before "On battery".
  • While charging, the large reading in the controls is the charging power.
  • A steadier estimated time, calculated from the battery's capacity and power.
  • Optional: show the charge in the menu bar (Settings → Battery → Menu bar).

item.title: PeakGlow 1.9.0
item.description:
PeakGlow 1.9.0

  • Battery: charge, estimated time, adapter and charging power in the controls, a Battery page in Settings, and a battery line in the menu bar menu.
  • Charging shows in the glow as a soft green light, and plugging in opens an island out of the notch, like iOS.
  • The glow now stops drawing when nothing changes, which uses much less CPU.

item.title: PeakGlow 1.8.0
item.description:
PeakGlow 1.8.0

  • Automatic updates: PeakGlow now checks for new versions about once a day.
  • A designed installer window: drag PeakGlow to Applications.
  • macOS 26 is supported.
  • A steadier power readout, one light haptic when the controls open, and less explanatory text.
  • Settings opens in front more reliably, and a Help menu was added.
